# Vue Nuxt Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Vue

## Overview

Builds server-rendered Vue applications with Nuxt 3 including auto-imports, server routes, and hybrid rendering strategies

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [vue-nuxt-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
vue-nuxt-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@vue-nuxt-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure Nuxt 3 with auto-imports and modules
- Implement server routes with H3 event handlers
- Set up hybrid rendering with route rules
- Build composables with useAsyncData and useFetch

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Nuxt 3 Guide**: Official Nuxt 3 patterns for SSR/SSG applications
- **Nitro Server**: Server route and API endpoint patterns
- **Rendering Modes**: Universal, client-only, and hybrid rendering
